name: Certn
summary: Certn lists self-serve per-check prices in Canadian dollars, such as 24.99 for a basic Canadian criminal record check and 29.99 for employment verification. It covers Canada, the US, the UK and international records, and it connects to Greenhouse, Lever, Workday and other ATS tools. Pass-through fees may apply.

facts.text: The criminal checks page lists Canadian CPIC, Quebec SOQUIJ, US multi-jurisdictional, federal and county records, UK checks and international databases in 200+ countries and territories.
To send a check, an employer needs only the candidate's name and email, and the candidate gets a secure link by SMS or email to complete it.
The same page mentions built-in consent forms as a compliance tool but does not describe their wording or when they appear.
The pricing page states prices are in Canadian dollars, and it lists the Public Records Check as Canada only and not available for US candidates.
The ATS page names Greenhouse, Lever and Workday and says status updates sync into the ATS.
